mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the calcium signal was most worthwhile: it connected the molecular action to the fibre shortening and showed that the filaments slide rather than shrink.

leastWorthwhile.text: Assembling the fibre scaffold and filling it with filaments was straightforward but less engaging; the separate steps added little explanation of how pulling works.

surprise.text: The result after adding ATP showed that it helps myosin release and reset, before calcium exposes the grip sites.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though combining the transporter-bearing cell with the fibre structures felt somewhat abstract until the scaffold appeared.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how the fibre connects to larger tissues and body systems, especially if later constructions explain their actions as clearly as the filament close-up.
